lines.text: Cast bread upon the waters and find it after many days, and divide your portion among seven, or even twelve.
A tree lies where it falls, and he who watches the wind will fail to sow.
You do not know the path of the wind, just as you cannot understand the work of God, the Maker.
Sow your seed in the morning and keep working in the evening, for you do not know which will succeed.
Light is sweet and it pleases the eyes to see the moon, and the days of darkness will be many.
